about: Six REAL rows, read by id (read-only, payload + dense) on 2026-10-09 from the build box twin
aw_e8 and from its 2026-09-22 snapshot copy (the snapshot the aw_e9 prod collection was built
from). prod_only_old: three rows of the L1 re-fetch batch 00001 that the twin rewrote IN PLACE
after the snapshot. Prod aw_e9 still holds the snapshot row for them: measured equal to the
copy row put in aw_e9 form (no BM25 epoch stamp), on all keys and dense. Their ids are
uuid5(canonical url # digest): the rewrite kept the text, so the digest, so the id.
equal: three news rows that prod holds exactly as the twin does (twin row in aw_e9 form, no
stamp). The tests build the prod rows from these (copy for prod_only_old, twin for equal);
nothing else is made up. The pack row of each prod_only_old id is the twin row (payload equal
key for key, dense within 5.3e-5, checked at capture).
